question: Prabha Atre is mainly related to which gharana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana Gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prabha Atre** is an Indian classical vocalist from the **Kirana Gharana**.
 
• The name of this musical school derives from Kirana or Kairana, a town and tehsil of Shamli District in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It is the** birthplace of Abdul Karim Khan**, a the founder of this Gharana.
 
• Prabha Atre is renowned as an academician, researcher, composer, author, guru, and reformer in addition to being a highly esteemed vocalist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhindi Bazaar Gharana:**

 
 
• Named after the Bhendi Bazaar locality of Mumbai, this Gharana prominently emphasizes the beauty of the raga rather than excessive rhythmic play.
 
• **Naina Devi, Shivkumar Shukla, Anwar Hussain Khan** belonged to the Bhindi Bazaar Gharana.
 
 
 
• **Agra Gharana:**
 
 
• Known for its forceful and vigorous rendition of Khayal, the Agra Gharana has distinguished itself by maintaining Dhrupad-style singing, which adds complexity and depth in the presentation of the Raga.
 
• **Ustad Faiyaz Khan, Ustad Vilayat Hussain Khan, Ustad Latafat Hussain Khan** belonged to the Agra Gharana.
 
 
 
• **Gwalior Gharana:**
 
 
• Known as one of the oldest Khyal Gharanas, the Gwalior Gharana has made significant contributions to Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar, Gangubai Hangal, Miyan Tansen** belonged to the Gwalior Gharana.
